summary: Frontend-only UI testing of /ics/consolidated (Invoicing Consolidated Management). Verified 32-col LHDN table, Expand filter panel, complete toolbar, buyer pinning to General Public / EI00000000010, currency label '(MYR)Malaysian Ringgit', S-XXXXXXX-S-XXXXXXX doc number format, footer totals row, red brand accent (CSS var --accent = '355 96% 55%'). Invoice Preview modal opens with breadcrumb 'Invoicing Consolidated Management / Invoice Preview', renders Sections A-B-C on page 1 with all required fields (EI00000000010, General Public, (86201)General medical services, Teluk Intan, Jalan Raja, MALAYSIA); Next advances to page 2 rendering Sections D-E-F-G-H including 'Consolidated e-Invoice' classification, 'No Data' for Section G, and Section H summary chips. Previous returns to page 1. Cancel closes the modal. Regression: View Invalid Reasons, Operation Log, Check Incompleted Fields, Run Consolidate Task (TIN dropdown loads via /api/ics/tin-list), and Export (CSV download 'consolidated-*.csv') all function.
action_items: MINOR: React console warning 'Encountered two children with the same key C99999999999' when opening the Run Consolidate Task dialog — /api/ics/tin-list returns duplicate TIN entries. De-duplicate on server or use a composite key (tin+label) in the SelectItem key in IcsConsolidated.jsx RunDialog.
critical_code_review_comments: IcsConsolidated.jsx is ~980 LOC and mixes 6 dialogs + table + filter in one file — consider splitting PreviewDialog, RunDialog, ReasonsDialog, OpLogDialog, IncompleteDialog into ./components/ subfiles for maintainability.

consolidatedDocNo() uses parseInt(...,'16') of last-6 hex chars — collision risk across large datasets is acceptable for display but numbers are not truly unique; if used as identifier consider suffixing with index.
Toolbar 'Submit' button is a Link that always navigates even when disabled=true (Button asChild + Link is not blocked by disabled). Minor UX issue.
Client-side pinning of Buyer TIN/Name is fine for UI but Export CSV also hardcodes it — ensure backend consolidation actually enforces General Public buyer at persistence time.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 spec checkpoints pass. Only outstanding item is duplicate-key React warning in Run Consolidate dialog's Issuer TIN Select — cosmetic. Modal wizard tested with idx=0 (first row) so page-1 Previous goes to page-0 state (disabled). To test cross-row navigation, select a row at idx > 0.
